content.text: I have the facts I need. Before writing, I'll record the verified findings in a session note so they survive context compaction.

arguments.code:
async ({ session: { setNote } }) => setNote("issue32-findings", `Verified vs code (all 302 tests green baseline; installed dev deps with npm ci --ignore-scripts):
- WRONG in docs: "Input is sanitized" overbroad. sanitizeInput (HTML comments, U+200B/C/D, FEFF, AD) applies to trigger text (comment/body w/ phrase), follow-ups, /answer, question titles. Issue title, issueBody (github.ts extractTriggerInfo subject.body raw), PR diff, review comments go to model UNSANITIZED.
- Custom template replaces whole first prompt: RUNNER_REQUIREMENTS block NOT appended. Template only for FIRST msg of NEW thread; follow-ups = formatFollowUp "**@login** commented (url):\\n\\ntask"; answers use own msg. Undocumented var {{reviewComments}} (camelCase). number="0", body="" for direct; trigger_comment=task for direct. Whitespace template -> default.
- pr_number task default "Please review this pull request". prompt w/o pr_number needs output_mode output.
- extensions LOCAL_PATH also accepts ~/ ; '#' comment lines skipped in extensions input.
- ui omitted only in output mode or no issue (direct). pr_number+comment gets ui.
- Bots ticking boxes: only allowed_bots check (no role check).
- agent commit-msg hook regex rejects 'feat!:' ; prepare-commit-msg: first digit run in branch, skip if commitSource set or #N present; hooks dir via git rev-parse --git-path hooks.
- Tests read README input table: src/action-docs.test.ts, src/defaults.test.ts (anchor '### Examples' after table).
- CONTRIBUTING: CI runs npm run check; missing dogfood workflows pi-direct-dogfood, pi-pr-review-dogfood; tests use faux provider + real scratch git repos (not 'mock pi SDK'); test-setup.ts strips GIT_* env; release: v2 moving major tag exists.
- comments-only example drops /answer + box-tick answers.
- success comment footer: thread ref + git fetch cmd.
Plan: docs/ tree: inputs.md(table, tests), workflows.md, models.md, extensions.md(+questions), threads.md, prompts.md(merge examples/prompt-templates.md), security.md, how-it-works.md; README landing; add link-check + template-var tests.`)
